messages:
Mia: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a Console card to show per-route KPI provenance. Want to attach kernel/batching/KV signals so product owners can see why p99 moved.
Jon: Love it. Minimal signals: kernel_choice, kernel_latency_ms, batch_size, queue_ms, kv_hit_rate, fallback_count, model_variant, seq_len_p50,p95.
Sophie: Also add route_sample_rate and prefix_cache_hits. And a token-level breakdown: kv_lookup / compute / io / scheduling.
Eli: Heads up — high cardinality (kernel+batch+seq_len per route) will explode ingestion costs. We should do pre-aggregation and sample 1% of requests for token-level slices.
Mia: Agreed. Plan: full metrics for rollups (p50/p95/p99, tps, err) per route+kernel choice, sampled token-level traces with tags. I'd like the UI to show 'Most likely cause' computed by simple attribution heuristic.
Jon: UI idea: compact card with p50/p95/p99 sparkline, small dropdown for kernel/batch filter, and a right-side mini-table listing top attribution signals.
Sophie: FYI, found a regression on staging: after kernel_autopick v2 we saw p99 ↑ 22% on chat-long sequences. log snippet:
```
route: chat-stream
kernel: cu_attn_v2
p99_before_ms: 312
p99_after_ms: 382
kv_hit_rate: 0.67
fallbacks: 3
```
Mia: That matches profiling — v2 skips a warmup path and increases early-step compute. Can eng-runtime expose kernel_selection_reason and batching_decision in traces?
eng-runtime: added kernel_selection_reason and batching_decision tags to tracing events on staging. Will push to prod after perf smoke tests.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: console-kpi-provenance v1 -> staging :white_check_mark:
Eli: For ingestion, we'll keep full cardinality for rollups for 7d, then roll up to hourly for 60d. Sampled token traces retained 10k per route per day.
Jon: Nice. Mia, can you add a mockup to the Console design doc? I can wire up the chart once the tags land.
Mia: Will do — dropping a link to the mockup in #product-design shortly. Thanks all :pray:
